desc: Ideation: reduce problem to per-window median cost plus weighted interval scheduling / cardinality DP.
Implement compact sliding-window median cost array using coordinate-compressed Fenwick trees (counts and sums).
Implement final rolling DP for exactly k non-overlapping length-x windows and replace placeholder return with DP answer.
Verify by running examples, edge cases, and small random brute-force; fix any off-by-one, invalid-state, or performance issues.
